crossRefs.note: Open the gates, that the righteous nation may enter: the one which keeps faith.
Blessed are those who do his commandments, that they may have the right to the tree of life, and may enter in by the…
Have mercy on me, Yahweh. See my affliction by those who hate me, and lift me up from the gates of death,
that I may show all of your praise. I will rejoice in your salvation in the gates of the daughter of Zion.
I will come into your temple with burnt offerings. I will pay my vows to you,
Let’s come before his presence with thanksgiving. Let’s extol him with songs!
Enter into his gates with thanksgiving, and into his courts with praise. Give thanks to him, and bless his name.
I will pay my vows to Yahweh, yes, in the presence of all his people,
in the courts of Yahweh’s house, in the middle of you, Jerusalem. Praise Yah!
Yahweh will save me. Therefore we will sing my songs with stringed instruments all the days of our life in Yahweh’s…
Hezekiah also had said, “What is the sign that I will go up to Yahweh’s house?”

translations.web: Open to me the gates of righteousness. I will enter into them. I will give thanks to Yah.
translations.bsb: Open to me the gates of righteousness, that I may enter and give thanks to the LORD.
translations.kjv: Open to me the gates of righteousness: I will go into them, and I will praise the LORD:
translations.asv: Open to me the gates of righteousness: I will enter into them, I will give thanks unto Jehovah.
